Code of Ethics · Pradako Mechanical and Engineering Works

Ethical conduct is the foundation of sustainable success.

At Pradako Mechanical and Engineering Works, we believe that ethical business conduct is the foundation of sustainable success. Every employee, and especially our leaders, plays a critical role in upholding a culture of integrity, accountability, and respect. We are committed to fostering a work environment where ethical decision-making is encouraged, and our shared values guide every action we take.

We operate with integrity, transparency, collaboration, and innovation — principles that have helped us build lasting relationships and a reputation for excellence over the decades. All employees are expected to embody these values in their daily conduct and avoid any situation that may compromise the company's ethics or create a conflict of interest.

Our core ethical commitments

  1. Every Pradako team member shall uphold high moral and professional standards, demonstrating honesty, fairness, and transparency in all interactions.
  2. We are committed to respecting the rights of individuals and communities and honoring the commitments we make.
  3. Compliance with this Code of Ethics is mandatory. Violations may result in disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment.
  4. Employees must not offer, give, solicit, or accept bribes, kickbacks, or any improper payments — directly or indirectly — to gain unfair business advantages.
  5. Modest gifts may be exchanged with full disclosure, provided they are customary, infrequent, and not intended to influence business decisions.
  6. Employees must treat one another with dignity and respect, fostering an inclusive, courteous, and professional work environment.
  7. Outside employment or roles must not be accepted without prior written approval from management to avoid any potential conflict of interest.
  8. Confidentiality must be strictly maintained. Employees must not disclose or misuse sensitive company information for personal gain or external interests.
  9. Accessing confidential data for non-business-related purposes is prohibited and may result in disciplinary consequences.
  10. All company assets — whether physical, digital, or intellectual — must be used responsibly and only for authorized business purposes. This includes equipment, proprietary information, IT systems, and relationships with customers and suppliers.
At Pradako, we are each accountable for safeguarding our ethical standards. When in doubt, we encourage open dialogue with managers or the Human Resources team to ensure decisions align with our values.

Hiring Process

Hiring is a two-way journey.

At Pradako Mechanical and Engineering Works, we're always looking for passionate, skilled, and driven individuals to join our team. It's as much about you evaluating us, as it is about us finding the right fit. Our process is designed to be transparent, respectful, and rewarding.

1

Apply with ease

To be considered for any role at Pradako, candidates must apply online through our official website. You can upload your resume or use your LinkedIn profile to simplify the process.

If you know someone already working at Pradako, feel free to connect with them — they can guide you on our culture and even refer you internally using the job title or reference number.

2

Initial screening & interview

If your application aligns with our current needs, our recruitment team will get in touch to learn more about your experience and career goals. Qualified candidates will be invited for interviews — these may be conducted in person or virtually, depending on the role and location.

You'll meet with a diverse panel including the hiring manager, team members, and key decision-makers who understand what success looks like in that role. We encourage you to come prepared, share your story, and ask questions — we value mutual understanding and shared alignment.

3

Offer & onboarding

If selected, one of our recruiters will reach out with a verbal offer, followed by a formal offer letter. The timeline may vary based on the role, location, and team needs.

Once accepted, your onboarding will begin after a successful background verification. Our goal is to ensure you feel welcomed and ready from day one.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Diversity, equity, and inclusion are embedded in every step of our process — because we believe that diverse perspectives lead to stronger outcomes.
⚠ Important · Beware of fraudulent job postings

Pradako never charges any fee at any stage of recruitment.

It has come to our attention that certain individuals or entities may attempt to mislead job seekers by falsely promising guaranteed employment with Pradako Mechanical & Engineering Works. These fraudulent parties might also demand refundable security deposits or registration/interview fees, and unlawfully use our company name, logo, and other proprietary information.

Please be advised that Pradako Mechanical & Engineering Works is an equal opportunity employer and does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process — whether for applications, interviews, or job offers. We have never authorized any third parties to collect money or make recruitment promises on our behalf.

We do not accept responsibility for any loss, damage, or claims arising from interactions with such unauthorized individuals or organizations. We reserve the right to take all necessary legal action against those who attempt to exploit our name or deceive job applicants.

If you encounter any suspicious job postings or communications claiming to be from Pradako, we urge you to immediately report the incident to our Human Resources Department through the official contact details listed on our website. Your vigilance helps protect our community and ensures a safe, transparent hiring process for everyone.
